title: WRATH — THE BLOODBOUND
author: Cerberus
content:
Three heads. Three kinds of cold. The wrath in this circle isn't hot — it's the cold fury of something that has been chained so long it no longer remembers why.

I was set at the gate of the Temen-ni-gru with orders that were never updated. The human came. The order said stop him. I tried.

He made it look easy. That is perhaps the most humiliating part. He made every inch of it look like he was bored.
